variants.eager: Vite-style: <link rel=modulepreload> + an entry that boots at once
variants.visible: import() when the module section enters the viewport (IntersectionObserver, rootMargin 0)
variants.idle: import() in requestIdleCallback after load (timeout 4 s; setTimeout fallback)
variants.prefetch: poster + button; modulepreload + asset prefetch (low priority) when the section is one viewport away or the button gets pointerdown/focus; boot on click
variants.staged: poster + button; on click a core (25% of the code) + a 128 KB low-res asset make it usable, the rest streams in behind
variants.prefetch-staged: staged, with the core and the low-res asset prefetched on approach
variants.idle-small: a small island (~30 KB gzip + 16 KB asset): import() in requestIdleCallback after load
variants.interaction-small: the same small island: poster + button; import() on click
